# docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md, "Draft, bill and passage". Country scope. Read by
# te_tax_bill_effects.txt, te_tax_triggers.txt, te_tax_support_values.txt and the support
# refresh (te_tax_gen_refresh_support); every variable read is guarded with has_variable,
# and none writes or iterates anything, so a GUI may read them too.

# One vanilla tax level per channel, for the support model's delta-levels.
te_tax_level_step_wage = 0.05
te_tax_level_step_div = 0.05
te_tax_level_step_land = 0.15
te_tax_level_step_head = 0.15
te_tax_level_step_cons = 0.05

# te_tax_base_<record>_<key>: the index in force under existing law in the draft's (dr) or
# the bill's (bl) due month: the enacted value, its successor if its sunset falls by then,
# then each awaiting package due earlier (one due on or after it is superseded at
# approval), with that package's own sunset preview. The draft's untouched provisions
# start from it; the bill's support model measures change against it.

				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_div
				var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pa_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_bl_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pb_div
				var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pb_div
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pb_div_succ
					var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0
					var:te_tax_pb_div_exp <= var:te_tax_bl_due
					var:te_tax_pb_div_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ
			}
		}
	}
}

# te_tax_base_<record>_<relief>: the relief band in force under existing law in the record's
# due month (relief has no sunset): the enacted band, then each awaiting package due earlier.
te_tax_base_dr_agrel = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_agrel } value = var:te_tax_en_agrel }
	# Awaiting packages due earlier, in the order they commence.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_agrel var:te_tax_pb_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_agrel }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_agrel var:te_tax_pa_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_agrel }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_agrel var:te_tax_pa_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_agrel }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_agrel var:te_tax_pb_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_agrel }
	}
}

# te_tax_dr_eff_<key>: the draft's target, or the baseline when the draft leaves it alone.
te_tax_dr_eff_wage = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_wage
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_wage var:te_tax_dr_wage >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_wage }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_div = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_div
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_div var:te_tax_dr_div >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_div }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_land = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_land
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_land var:te_tax_dr_land >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_land }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_head = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_head
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_head var:te_tax_dr_head >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_head }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_cons = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_cons
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_cons var:te_tax_dr_cons >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_cons }
}
te_tax_dr_eff_agrel = {

	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_agrel var:te_tax_dr_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_agrel }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_regrel var:te_tax_dr_regrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_dr_regrel }
}

# te_tax_dr_zero_limit_<key>: Traditionalism's test that the draft levies no such tax,
# written with the draft's index on the left (te_tax_draft_ready):
#   var:te_tax_dr_<key> = 0  OR  var:te_tax_dr_<key> <= te_tax_dr_zero_limit_<key>
# The limit is -1 when existing law in the draft's month has no such tax and -2 when it
# has, so an untouched provision (-1) passes exactly when that law levies none, and a
# touched one only at 0.
te_tax_dr_zero_limit_wage = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_wage
	max = 1
	multiply = -1
	add = -1
}
te_tax_dr_zero_limit_div = {
	value = te_tax_base_dr_div
	max = 1
	multiply = -1
	add = -1
}

# te_tax_base_<record>_g_<good>: 1 if the good is taxed under existing law in the
# draft's (dr) or the bill's (bl) due month.
te_tax_base_dr_g_aeroplanes = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes } value = var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes }
	# Awaiting packages due earlier, in the order they commence.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes }
	}
}

# Customs (plan Task 15): te_tax_base_<record>_<d>_<good>, the level in force under existing law
# in the draft's (dr) or the bill's (bl) due month: the enacted record while the code holds the
# country's customs, else vanilla's default (1, low tariffs), then each awaiting package due
# earlier that sets it (a package field of -3 or more; -99 leaves a level alone).
# te_tax_dr_eff_<d>_<good>: the draft's level, or that baseline while the draft leaves it alone.
te_tax_base_dr_imp_advanced_materials = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_customs_held var:te_tax_customs_held = 1 has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_advanced_materials } value = var:te_tax_en_imp_advanced_materials }
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials var:te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials var:te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials var:te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_advanced_materials }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials var:te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_advanced_materials }
	}
}

	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_customs_held var:te_tax_customs_held = 1 has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_motor_ships } value = var:te_tax_en_imp_motor_ships }
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pb_imp_motor_ships var:te_tax_pb_imp_motor_ships >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_motor_ships }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pa_imp_motor_ships var:te_tax_pa_imp_motor_ships >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_motor_ships }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pa_imp_motor_ships var:te_tax_pa_imp_motor_ships >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_motor_ships }

	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_customs_held var:te_tax_customs_held = 1 has_variable = te_tax_en_imp_groceries } value = var:te_tax_en_imp_groceries }

		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_bl_due } has_variable = te_tax_pb_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pb_imp_groceries var:te_tax_pb_imp_groceries >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pb_imp_groceries }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_bl_due } has_variable = te_tax_pa_pver_customs has_variable = te_tax_pa_imp_groceries var:te_tax_pa_imp_groceries >= -3 } value = var:te_tax_pa_imp_groceries }

# The bill's change of each customs level, in level steps from existing law in its month (0 if it
# leaves the level alone); per category and direction the support model reads their sum
# (te_tax_bl_dcu_<d>_<category>, CUSTOMS_POINTS), and the offers how many it changes
# (te_tax_bl_customs_changed).

	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_tanks = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_tanks = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_tea = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_tea = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_tech_metals = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_tech_metals = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_telephones = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_telephones = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_tobacco = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_tobacco = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_tools = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_tools = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_tourism = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_tourism = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_wine = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_wine = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_wood = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_exp_wood = 0 } } add = 1 }
}

# The bill's change per instrument: in index steps (0 if untouched), then in vanilla tax levels.
te_tax_bl_dstep_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_wage var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_wage
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_wage
	}
}

	value = te_tax_bl_dstep_wage
	multiply = te_tax_step_wage
	divide = te_tax_level_step_wage

# The bill's change in agricultural relief, in bands from existing law (0 if untouched); the
# support model scales it by the wage tax it relieves (te_tax_bl_agrel_scaled,
# te_tax_support_values.txt). Regional relief is scored by coverage instead
# (te_tax_bl_regrel_coverage).
te_tax_bl_dstep_agrel = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_agrel var:te_tax_bl_agrel >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_agrel
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_agrel
	}
}

# The bill's goods, in tax levels on the consumption channel: 0.2 per good it puts on
# the taxed list (negative for one it takes off), times the good's category weight
# (GOODS_CATEGORY_WEIGHT in the generator, from the goods file's category). One value per
# good, so a later provision can zero a single good's term; te_tax_dl_goods is their sum.
# Customs (plan Task 15; spec 6, combined incidence): a good the bill takes off the taxed list
# while raising its import level earns no affordability bonus, so its negative term is
# held at 0 (min = 0); a tax the bill adds is never zeroed.
te_tax_dl_g_aeroplanes = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes var:te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes
		subtract = te_tax_base_bl_g_aeroplanes
		multiply = 0.04
		if = { limit = { te_tax_bl_dstep_imp_aeroplanes > 0 } min = 0 }
	}
}

# The rates' change in tax levels (te_tax_dl_total). The revenue direction the fiscal reason
# reads (te_tax_dl_revenue, plan Task 13) adds the goods the bill taxes (te_tax_dl_goods) and
# subtracts the relief it grants, in tax levels forgone: te_tax_agrel_revenue_levels per
# scaled band of agricultural relief and te_tax_regrel_revenue_levels per unit of regional
# coverage (te_tax_support_values.txt). Read only by the support refresh: the coverage
# iterates a state list. Progressivity: income channels minus the rest, and every staple
# the bill taxes counts as regressive.
te_tax_dl_total = {
	value = te_tax_dl_wage
	add = te_tax_dl_div
	add = te_tax_dl_land
	add = te_tax_dl_head
	add = te_tax_dl_cons
}
te_tax_dl_revenue = {
	value = te_tax_dl_total
	add = te_tax_dl_goods
	subtract = { value = te_tax_bl_agrel_scaled multiply = te_tax_agrel_revenue_levels }
	subtract = { value = te_tax_bl_regrel_coverage multiply = te_tax_regrel_revenue_levels }
}
te_tax_dl_prog = {
	value = te_tax_dl_wage
	add = te_tax_dl_div
	subtract = te_tax_dl_land
	subtract = te_tax_dl_head
	subtract = te_tax_dl_cons
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_grain
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_clothes
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_furniture
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_groceries
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_fabric
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_fish
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_wood
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_electricity
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_paper
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_services
	subtract = te_tax_dl_g_transportation
}

# How many provisions the bill changes.
te_tax_bl_provisions = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_wage var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_div var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_land var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_head var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_cons var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0 } add = 1 }
}

# Support reasons per interest group, each clamped to -40..40. Material:
# -10 x the exposure-weighted change in tax levels, the bill's goods counted on the
# consumption channel (te_tax_dl_goods); then relief in points: agricultural, per band the
# bill moves it scaled by the wage tax relieved (te_tax_bl_agrel_scaled),
# rural_folk +8, landowners +3; regional, per band x share of the population
# named over te_tax_regrel_ref_share (te_tax_bl_regrel_coverage), +4 for every group,
# industrialists -2, petty_bourgeoisie -2 on top; customs (plan Task 15), per level step of a
# category's goods (te_tax_bl_dcu_<d>_<category>, CUSTOMS_POINTS in the generator). Ideology: 5 x the
# group's fiscal ideology (its stances on the vanilla taxation laws x their progressiveness
# / 100) x the change in progressivity. Government: +10 in government. Trust
# (plan Task 12): 10 x the group's te_tax_trust_<ig>, +1 per promise kept and -1 per
# promise broken.
te_tax_mat_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_wage multiply = 0.3 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_div multiply = 0.2 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_land multiply = 0.1 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_head multiply = 0.3 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_cons multiply = 0.4 }
	add = { value = te_tax_dl_goods multiply = 0.4 }
	multiply = -10
	add = { value = te_tax_bl_regrel_coverage multiply = 4 }
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_ideo_p_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	# law_consumption_based_taxation, progressiveness -100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 1 }
	# law_land_based_taxation, progressiveness -50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > approve } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	# law_proportional_taxation, progressiveness 50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	# law_graduated_taxation, progressiveness 100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -1 }
}
te_tax_ideo_armed_forces = {
	value = te_tax_ideo_p_armed_forces
	multiply = te_tax_dl_prog
	multiply = 5
	min = -40
	max = 40
}
te_tax_gov_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { is_in_government = yes } } value = 10 }
}
te_tax_trust_reason_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_trust_armed_forces } value = var:te_tax_trust_armed_forces multiply = 10 }
	min = -40
	max = 40
}

	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	# law_proportional_taxation, progressiveness 50
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 0.5 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -0.5 }
	# law_graduated_taxation, progressiveness 100
	if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } add = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } add = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } add = -2 }
	else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } add = -1 }
}

# Clout of the non-marginal interest groups, and of those among them committed to the
# bill's current revision (te_tax_committed_share, te_tax_support_values.txt). A marginal
# group (vanilla's ig_counts_as_marginal) counts in neither; a group the country lacks
# contributes nothing.
te_tax_eligible_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}
te_tax_committed_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout
			var:te_tax_com_devout = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_devout_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners
			var:te_tax_com_landowners = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_landowners_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 1
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev
			has_variable = te_tax_bl_rev
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions_rev = var:te_tax_bl_rev
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}

# Clout of the non-marginal groups that are persuadable (not committed, no red line, a
# score of 0 or more): the passage bar's pale segment (te_tax_view_open_share).
te_tax_open_clout = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_com_armed_forces = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_armed_forces
			var:te_tax_sup_armed_forces >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_devout
			var:te_tax_com_devout = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_devout
			var:te_tax_sup_devout >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_industrialists
			var:te_tax_com_industrialists = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_industrialists
			var:te_tax_sup_industrialists >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_com_intelligentsia = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_intelligentsia
			var:te_tax_sup_intelligentsia >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_landowners
			var:te_tax_com_landowners = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_landowners
			var:te_tax_sup_landowners >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_com_petty_bourgeoisie = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie
			var:te_tax_sup_petty_bourgeoisie >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_com_rural_folk = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_rural_folk
			var:te_tax_sup_rural_folk >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
			has_variable = te_tax_com_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_com_trade_unions = 0
			has_variable = te_tax_sup_trade_unions
			var:te_tax_sup_trade_unions >= 0
		}
		add = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
	}
}

# The panels' draft class and "reverts to" preview (plan Task 8). te_tax_dr_dstep_<key>
# and te_tax_dr_provisions are the bill's values for the draft, so the workbench can show
# the class the bill would have (te_tax_draft_is_minor, te_tax_triggers.txt).
te_tax_dr_dstep_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_wage var:te_tax_dr_wage >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_wage
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_wage
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_div = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_div var:te_tax_dr_div >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_div
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_div
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_land = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_land var:te_tax_dr_land >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_land
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_land
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_head = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_head var:te_tax_dr_head >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_head
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_head
	}
}
te_tax_dr_dstep_cons = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_cons var:te_tax_dr_cons >= 0 }
		value = var:te_tax_dr_cons
		subtract = te_tax_base_dr_cons
	}
}
te_tax_dr_provisions = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_wage var:te_tax_dr_wage >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_div var:te_tax_dr_div >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_land var:te_tax_dr_land >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_head var:te_tax_dr_head >= 0 } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_dr_cons var:te_tax_dr_cons >= 0 } add = 1 }
}

# te_tax_succ_dr_<key>: the index a sunset in the draft would revert to (scheduler rule 3
# at the draft's due month; the review's "then reverts to").
te_tax_succ_dr_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_en_wage } value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
	# Any pending enacted sunset: its successor is the underlying rate.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_tax_en_wage_exp
			has_variable = te_tax_en_wage_succ
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
			var:te_tax_en_wage_succ >= 0
		}
		value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ
	}
	# Awaiting packages due earlier, in the order they commence.
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_slot_b_first = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = b DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pb_wage
				var:te_tax_pb_wage >= 0

		}

				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage
				var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0

					var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ >= 0

				value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_slot_awaits_before = { SLOT = a DUE = te_tax_dr_due }
				has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage
				var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0
			}
			value = var:te_tax_pa_wage
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage_exp
					has_variable = te_tax_pa_wage_succ

					var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ >= 0
				}
				value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ

# Offers (plan Task 13). te_tax_bl_eff_wage and te_tax_bl_eff_agrel: the bill's wage index
# and agricultural relief band, or existing law's in its month when the bill leaves them
# alone; the relief offer adds a band to the second while the first leaves a tax to relieve.
te_tax_bl_eff_wage = {
	value = te_tax_base_bl_wage
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_wage var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_bl_wage }
}
te_tax_bl_eff_agrel = {
	value = te_tax_base_bl_agrel
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_agrel var:te_tax_bl_agrel >= 0 } value = var:te_tax_bl_agrel }
}

# How many instruments and catalog goods the bill changes from existing law in its month,
# not merely restates (te_tax_offer_cut_leaves_a_bill, te_tax_offer_untax_leaves_a_bill).
te_tax_bl_changed_provisions = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_wage = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_div = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_land = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_head = 0 } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_bl_dstep_cons = 0 } } add = 1 }
}

# te_tax_bl_grief_<ig>_<key>: what the bill's raise of an instrument costs the group, in tax
# levels weighted by its exposure (te_tax_dl_<key> x EXPOSURE), 0 unless the bill raises it
# above existing law (te_tax_bl_dstep_<key> above 0); te_tax_bl_grief_<ig>_goods the same for
# the goods the bill taxes on the consumption channel, 0 unless they add to the burden. The
# largest is the group's top grievance, the one a clause offer softens (controller ruling:
# a clause only softens what the bill raises).
te_tax_bl_grief_armed_forces_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_bl_dstep_wage > 0 } value = te_tax_dl_wage multiply = 0.3 }
}
te_tax_bl_grief_armed_forces_div = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_bl_dstep_div > 0 } value = te_tax_dl_div multiply = 0.2 }
}
te_tax_bl_grief_armed_forces_land = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_bl_dstep_land > 0 } value = te_tax_dl_land multiply = 0.1 }
}
te_tax_bl_grief_armed_forces_head = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_bl_dstep_head > 0 } value = te_tax_dl_head multiply = 0.3 }
}
te_tax_bl_grief_armed_forces_cons = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_bl_dstep_cons > 0 } value = te_tax_dl_cons multiply = 0.4 }
}
te_tax_bl_grief_armed_forces_goods = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_dl_goods > 0 } value = te_tax_dl_goods multiply = 0.4 }
}

	if = { limit = { te_tax_bl_dstep_div > 0 } value = te_tax_dl_div multiply = 0.2 }

# te_tax_prom_<ig>: the group's promises reason, recomputed at every refresh from the
# promises accepted under this bill (te_tax_bl_prom_<ig>_*), never accumulated. Its own
# accepted promise counts te_tax_offer_points, or te_tax_offer_points_maint if it only
# maintains what already holds, and only while its pending obligation is live
# (te_tax_offer_prom_live: a promise that could not be recorded, because the same one is
# already pending or binding, adds nothing). Another group's institution promise counts
# -3 per step of the group's stance on the law with none of that institution
# (law_no_schools, law_no_health_system): a group that wants the institution welcomes it.
te_tax_prom_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { te_tax_offer_prom_live_maint = { IG = armed_forces } } add = te_tax_offer_points_maint }
	else_if = { limit = { te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = armed_forces } } add = te_tax_offer_points }
	# Another group's schools promise.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_arg = 1 te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = rural_folk } }
				AND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_arg = 1 te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = devout } }
				AND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_arg = 1 te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = intelligentsia } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value > approve } } } add = -6 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value > neutral } } } add = -3 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value < disapprove } } } add = 6 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value < neutral } } } add = 3 }
	}
	# Another group's health promise.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_trade_unions_arg = 2 te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = trade_unions } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_health_system value > approve } } } add = -6 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_health_system value > neutral } } } add = -3 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_health_system value < disapprove } } } add = 6 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_health_system value < neutral } } } add = 3 }
	}
	min = -40
	max = 40
}

				AND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_rural_folk_arg = 1 te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = rural_folk } }
				AND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_devout_arg = 1 te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = devout } }
				AND = { has_variable = te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_kind = 1 var:te_tax_bl_prom_intelligentsia_arg = 1 te_tax_offer_prom_live = { IG = intelligentsia } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value > approve } } } add = -6 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value > neutral } } } add = -3 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value < disapprove } } } add = 6 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_trade_unions ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_no_schools value < neutral } } } add = 3 }
	}
	min = -40
	max = 40
}

# Interest-group views of the enacted code (plan Task 13; te_tax_gen_ig_views, from the
# monthly processor and te_tax.4). te_tax_ig_band_<ig>: the group's own vanilla stance, -2 strongly
# opposes .. 2 strongly endorses (law_stance, strongest bucket first), toward the vanilla
# taxation law the enacted code is equivalent to (te_tax_code_equivalent_<law>,
# te_tax_triggers.txt, which need the rule and the carrier law); 0 without the carrier, or
# for a neutral stance. Reads no variable and iterates nothing.
te_tax_ig_band_armed_forces = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_graduated = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_proportional = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_per_capita = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_land_based = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_consumption_based = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_armed_forces ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
}

		if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_proportional = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_per_capita = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_land_based = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_tax_code_equivalent_consumption_based = yes }
		if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > approve } } } value = 2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value > neutral } } } value = 1 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < disapprove } } } value = -2 }
		else_if = { limit = { ig:ig_rural_folk ?= { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation value < neutral } } } value = -1 }
	}
}

# The AI's offer order (plan 2026-10-03 Task 20; te_tax_gen_ai_accept_offer): each group's clout
# when the country has it and it is not marginal, else -1, and its rank, the number of groups
# ahead of it by clout, largest first, ties in a fixed order (an earlier group is ahead at equal
# clout, a later one only above it). Eligible groups take 0 to k-1; the rest 8.
te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces = {
	value = -1
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		value = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
	}
}
te_tax_ai_clout_devout = {
	value = -1
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		value = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
	}
}
te_tax_ai_clout_industrialists = {
	value = -1
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		value = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
	}
}

	value = -1

		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia

			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions

te_tax_ai_clout_rank_armed_forces = {
	value = 8
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces >= 0 }
		value = 0
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_devout > te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_industrialists > te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_intelligentsia > te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_landowners > te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_petty_bourgeoisie > te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_rural_folk > te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_trade_unions > te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces } add = 1 }
	}
}
te_tax_ai_clout_rank_devout = {
	value = 8
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_devout >= 0 }
		value = 0
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_armed_forces >= te_tax_ai_clout_devout } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_industrialists > te_tax_ai_clout_devout } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_intelligentsia > te_tax_ai_clout_devout } add = 1 }
		if = { limit = { te_tax_ai_clout_landowners > te_tax_ai_clout_devout } add = 1 }

# The AI's pre-score (plan 2026-10-03 Task 21; te_tax_gen_ai_pick_raise / _cut): the political
# cost of a +1 step on the instrument, the sum over the present, non-marginal groups of
#   clout x (10 x s x exposure - 5 x sign x s x P(ig))
# with s the step in tax levels (wage 0.5, div 0.5, land 0.16667, head 0.33333, cons 1),
# sign +1 for wage and div and -1 otherwise, and P(ig) te_tax_ideo_p_<ig>: the
# material and ideology reasons of the step with the sign turned. A cut's gain is the same
# value. Only the initiative reads it, to pick the instrument a template moves; the bill's
# own support refresh then judges the bill.
te_tax_ai_cost_wage = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_armed_forces
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 1.5
			multiply = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_devout
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 2
			multiply = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_industrialists
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 1
			multiply = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_intelligentsia
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 3
			multiply = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_landowners
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 0.5
			multiply = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie
			ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_petty_bourgeoisie
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 3
			multiply = ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_rural_folk
			ig:ig_rural_folk = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_rural_folk
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 2
			multiply = ig:ig_rural_folk.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_trade_unions
			ig:ig_trade_unions = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_trade_unions
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 5
			multiply = ig:ig_trade_unions.ig_clout
		}
	}
}
te_tax_ai_cost_div = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_armed_forces
			ig:ig_armed_forces = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_armed_forces
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 1
			multiply = ig:ig_armed_forces.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_devout
			ig:ig_devout = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_devout
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 1.5
			multiply = ig:ig_devout.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_industrialists
			ig:ig_industrialists = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_industrialists
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 5
			multiply = ig:ig_industrialists.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_intelligentsia
			ig:ig_intelligentsia = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_intelligentsia
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 1
			multiply = ig:ig_intelligentsia.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = ig:ig_landowners
			ig:ig_landowners = { ig_counts_as_marginal = no }
		}
		add = {
			value = te_tax_ideo_p_landowners
			multiply = -2.5
			add = 4
			multiply = ig:ig_landowners.ig_clout
		}
	}
	if = {
